summary: Stocks are falling as AI-spending worries (Meta) hit tech and oil rises to a five-month high on renewed Iran and Saudi attacks, while Treasury yields fall below 5% on safe-haven demand. This is a risk-off day that markets are already pricing, with no single new event large enough to justify a higher risk level or a veto.
